title.narrative: Citizen Voices Addressing Violence Against Children (CVAVAC)

description.narrative: The CVAVAC project is proposed by World Vision Ireland (WVIRE) in partnership with World Vision Lesotho (WVL) in order to promote improved justice for children. World has expertise in enhancing child protection in vulnerable communities and in youth led advocacy. WVL is the largest NGO in Lesotho, operating in community-based Area Programmes (APs) in 8 districts, with a strong focus on child rights promotion and child protection, including through advocacy.
